content: Hello! This is the Manhattan Suites reservation desk. How can I assist you today with your booking or payment confirmation?
Hi, I just wanted to double-check if my deposit for the upcoming stay under the name Sarah Lim has been received. I sent $320 via PayPal yesterday evening.

Thank you, Ms. Lim. I see a recent PayPal transaction for $320 under your account, sarah.lim1985@gmail.com, timestamped 19:46 on June 3rd. The confirmation code is PPX-219772. Is that the correct payment reference?
Yes, that's the confirmation code I got. Just want to ensure my booking from June 14th to 18th is secured.

You're all set for June 14th to 18th at Manhattan Suites, room 812. Your deposit is logged and the balance of $480 is due at check-in. If you need to make changes before June 10th, please call us at +1-212-555-0732 to avoid late amendment fees.
Great, thanks. Will I get an email receipt for this payment?

Absolutely. A payment receipt was sent to sarah.lim1985@gmail.com within minutes of the PayPal transfer. If you don't see it, check your spam folder or let us know by tomorrow, as we must finalize all deposit confirmations by 5 PM Tuesday.
I'll check my inbox and get back if I don't find it. Thanks for your help!
No problem at all, Ms. Lim. Your reservation is secure with us, just keep the PayPal confirmation PPX-219772 handy for any inquiries and reach out before Tuesday's deadline if you need anything.
